newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Paranagua stevedores still not decided over strike.
newsitem.headline: Paranagua stevedores still not decided over strike.

text.p: Stevedores at the key Brazilian port of Paranagua have still not decided whether to join in a planned nationwide strike by Brazilian stevedores on Friday, a spokeswoman said.
"For they moment they still do not have a position," said the spokeswoman for the Paranagua Stevedores' Union.

Their counterparts at Santos port started a 48-hour strike at 0700 local/100 GMT over a ruling which allows company workers from steel mill Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) to operate Cosipa's private terminal at the port.
The strike is scheduled to spread to the national level on Friday, the National Stevedores' Union said.
An official at the Paranagua Administrative Portworkers' Union said she knew of no plans by the port's workers to strike Friday.
"The portworkers, including those at the export terminal, do not have a strike planned for Friday," the official said.
